title: Sophia Lorenz Insurance Policy
content: Sophia Lorenz, renowned actress, has opted for our comprehensive insurance package, which includes asset protection and liability coverage. The policy was tailored to her specific needs, given her high-profile status and the diverse portfolio of assets. The annual premium for the policy is set at $2.3 million, reflecting the value and complexity of the coverage provided. Sophia's trust in Carter Elite Insurance Services is a testament to our commitment to providing exceptional service to our distinguished clientele.

title: Testimonial from Sophia Lorenz
content: Working with John Carter has been a revelation. His attention to detail and the bespoke service he provides are second to none. I feel completely secure knowing that my assets and interests are protected under his guidance. - Sophia Lorenz
